result.brief: 提出特征损失离散分词器 FeaTok，以重建预训练视觉特征替代像素重建，使 token 更利于生成建模，并在类条件与文本条件生成上超越离散与连续基线。
result.reason: Trains discrete image tokenizer by reconstructing pretrained features (SigLIP/DINOv2/v3) instead of pixels, improving generative token structure; directly a tokenizer/representation contribution.
